status.en: 96 armed incidents reported in the past seven days, 34% fewer than the week before, most of them in Gaza, Jerusalem and Hebron.
status.nb: 96 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 34 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Gaza, Jerusalem og Hebron.

summary.en: US President Trump announced that US military aid to Israel will end by the end of the year, while the UN rights office warned that displacement in Gaza is deepening into a nightmare. The Israeli Defence Forces identified senior Hamas commander Deif and other top leaders entering tunnels on the eve of the Oct. 7 attack and killed six terror operatives in Gaza strikes this week. Israeli security forces carried out mass arrests across the occupied West Bank and Palestinians returned to ruined homes in Hebron after a ten-day siege. 21,440 battle-related deaths were recorded in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: US-president Trump kunngjorde at amerikansk militærhjelp til Israel vil opphøre innen årsskiftet, mens FN-s rettskontor advarte om at fordrivelsen i Gaza utvikler seg til et mareritt. Israels forsvarsstyrker identifiserte senior Hamas-kommandør Deif og andre ledende personer som gikk inn i tunneler på kvelden før angrepet 7. oktober, og drepte seks terroroperatører i Gaza-angrep denne uken. Israels sikkerhetsstyrker gjennomførte massearrestasjoner på den okkuperte Vestbredden, og palestinere vendte tilbake til ødelagte hjem i Hebron etter en ti-dagers beleiring. 21 440 dødsfall knyttet til kamper ble registrert i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Gaza war
background.extract: The Gaza war is an armed conflict in the Gaza Strip and Israel, fought as part of the unresolved Israeli–Palestinian and Gaza–Israel conflicts. The war began on 7 October 2023, when Palestinian militant group Hamas led an attack on Israel, in which 1,195 Israelis and foreign nationals were killed and 251 were taken hostage. Since the start of the Israeli offensive that followed, over 74,000 Palestinians in Gaza have been killed; several studies in The Lancet indicate this figure is likely a significant undercount. Many scholarly sources and international organizations—including UN bodies, NGOs, and the International Association of Genocide Scholars—have concluded that Israel's actions in Gaza constitute genocide under international law. Several countries have also stated that genocide is occurring and have supported legal proceedings before the International Court of Justice. Israel and its supporters have denied that genocide has occurred.
background.extractNb: Krigen i Gaza er en krig mellom Israel og væpnede palestinske grupper, hovedsakelig Hamas, som har pågått på Gazastripen og i det sørlige Israel siden 7. oktober 2023. Konflikten er en del av den uløste Israel–Palestina-konflikten, og følger etter krigene i 2008–2009, 2014 og 2021.
